items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I stayed with them eighteen years. But that's when I started doing gigs with Joe.

ctx.x: What about the Wall Street insurance brokerage firm?

No, no. I was working for the Great American Insurance Company. See, I went to work there in '52, and I stayed there until they moved the company to California in 1970. I stayed with them eighteen years. But that's when I started doing gigs with Joe.
